acceptance.given: Static validation is invoked for a Skill declaration.

oracle.expected: Validation completes without invoking Context7, MCP, HTTPS, or any other lookup operation.
forbidden: An official HTTPS fallback lookup is invoked.
Any other lookup operation is invoked.
oracle.observable: Validator process trace and result show no lookup calls during static validation.

acceptance.then: The validator performs only local static checks and emits a completed validation result with no lookup execution.
acceptance.when: During the static-validation phase, before any runtime lookup would be allowed.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Run the static-validation selector with lookup calls instrumented or forbidden; fail if any lookup API, MCP connection, HTTPS fallback, or other lookup is observed.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Add or maintain a static-validation test that proves no lookup operation executes.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: No persistent state or schema change; revert validator and test together.

slice_hint.state_transition: Static validation executes local checks and records a no-lookup outcome.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The targeted test passes and its instrumentation confirms zero lookup invocations.

acceptance.given: A Skill is designated local-only and its declaration is loaded for validation.

oracle.expected: The metadata or validation contract explicitly records external API/version lookup as not applicable.
forbidden: The local-only Skill omits the not-applicable declaration.
The Skill states or implies that external API/version lookup is applicable.
oracle.observable: Parsed Skill metadata or validator output contains an explicit external-lookup-not-applicable declaration.

acceptance.then: The local-only declaration is accepted only when the explicit not-applicable statement is present.
acceptance.when: During declaration parsing and static contract validation.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Validate a local-only fixture lacking the explicit external API/version lookup not-applicable declaration and assert the declaration check fails.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Enforce and test an explicit not-applicable external lookup declaration for local-only Skills.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: No persistent state or schema change; revert validator and test together.

slice_hint.state_transition: A local-only Skill moves from undeclared lookup applicability to an explicit not-applicable declaration.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The local-only declaration test passes and the missing-declaration case is rejected.

acceptance.given: A version-sensitive Skill declaration is being validated and may encounter stale lookup information.

oracle.expected: The declaration contains an explicit policy describing how stale lookup information is handled.
forbidden: Stale-information handling is unspecified or absent.
oracle.observable: Parsed declaration or validation output includes a non-empty stale-information handling policy.

acceptance.then: Validation accepts the declaration only when stale-information behavior is explicitly recorded.
acceptance.when: During static inspection of version-sensitive lookup metadata and policy fields.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Validate a version-sensitive fixture with stale-information handling omitted and assert the policy-presence check fails.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Require and test an explicit stale-information handling policy in version-sensitive Skill declarations.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: No persistent state or schema change; revert validator and test together.

slice_hint.state_transition: A version-sensitive declaration moves from unspecified to explicitly governed stale-information behavior.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The stale-policy fixture passes and omission is reported as validation failure.

acceptance.given: A Skill is declared local-only while also declaring a network or API dependency.

oracle.expected: Validation returns a failing result identifying the contradiction between local-only status and the declared network/API dependency.
forbidden: The network/API dependency is ignored or treated as compatible with local-only status.
oracle.observable: Validator exit/result marks the fixture invalid and identifies the conflicting dependency.

acceptance.then: The contradictory local-only declaration is rejected.
acceptance.when: During static validation of the Skill capability/dependency declarations.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Execute the validator against a fixture declaring local-only together with a network/API dependency and observe a deterministic validation failure.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Reject local-only declarations that include network or API dependencies.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: No persistent state or schema change; revert validator and test together.

slice_hint.state_transition: A contradictory declaration transitions to an explicit validation failure.
